name: Monster Trainer Monster Researcher
body:
Monster researchers are dedicated students of monsters and their interactions with the world. They focus on the spellcasting aspects of monster training to tap into more potential than other trainers.

Researchers have very little time to commit to physical training. As a result, their talents in that area suffer, but they gain more esoteric knowledge of monsters and an increased pool of available spells.

Hit Dice and Base Attack

A monster researcher’s monster trainer Hit Die is a d6, and her base attack bonus is equal to one-half her monster trainer level. This alters the monster trainer’s Hit Dice and base attack.

Armor Proficiencies

The researcher is not proficient with any armor and suffers arcane spell failure in all armor types. This alters the monster trainer’s proficiencies.

Researcher’s Knowledge (Ex)

A monster researcher adds half her monster trainer level (minimum 1) to all monster lore Knowledge skill checks and may make all Knowledge skill checks related to monsters untrained.

Researcher’s Journal

A researcher uses her Intelligence as her spellcasting ability modifier, rather than Charisma.

Every researcher begins play with a journal in which she keeps a collection of spells granted by her captured monsters for easy use. This functions as a wizard’s spellbook, except as noted here.

Learning Spells

The spells a researcher adds to her journal for free are drawn from those granted by the monsters she has captured. At 1st level, this includes up to 10 common cantrips and a number of 1stlevel spells equal to 3 + the researcher’s Intelligence modifier.

The researcher need not add all of these spells immediately, choosing instead to add them from new monsters as she captures them. She adds additional spells to her journal as a wizard of her monster trainer level.

Preparing and Casting Spells: Each morning, a monster researcher can designate one or more of her monster trainer spell slots in which to prepare spells from her journal. Once a spell is prepared in one of these slots, it cannot be used to cast a spell granted by the researcher’s active monster until the next time she would prepare spells. The researcher can cast spells prepared in this way with or without an active monster.

When she casts a spell prepared with her journal, the researcher cannot cast it through her active monster unless that monster could grant her the spell normally.

Researching Spells: A monster researcher cannot research new monster trainer spells without having regular access to one or more monsters that can grant them to a trainer.

This ability alters the monster trainer’s spellcasting ability and replaces spell familiarity and channel monster.

Bonus Feat

At 13th level, a monster researcher gains one bonus feat from the following list: Extra Perk, Improved Familiar, or any item creation or metamagic feat. If she has the monster summoning trainer perk, she adds Augment Summoning to her list of available bonus feats as well.

Trainer Perks

In addition, the following trainer perks complement the researcher archetype: Appraise monster, extended calling, extraordinary channeler, familiar bond, monster summoning, skilled trainer, and supernatural channeler.
